question.text: In the given circuit, the binary inputs at $A$ and $B$ are both 1 in one case and both 0 in the next case. The respective outputs at $Y$ in these two cases will be

solution.text: The output of logic gate circuit for $$ \begin{array}{l} Y=\frac{}{A \cdot B+\bar{A} \bar{B}} \\ A=1 \end{array} $$ $$ B=1 \Rightarrow Y=0 $$ and for $\quad A=0, B=0$ $\Rightarrow \quad Y=0$
